question: Should storage/scaleway-object-storage-glacier-class be verdict paid-only rather than fails-egress, the way OVHcloud's Cold Archive record is?
why: The class has no free allowance at all and costs EUR 19 per TB to read out (EUR 9 restore plus EUR 10 egress), which is the shape of a paid tier rather than a free allowance that is too small. The verdict was left as the seed's gate-reading wave recorded it because flipping it changes the verdict every document prints.
